title: Record declaring absences that genuinely have no route
summary: Declares a not-collected and a never-defined absence, neither carrying wouldFill. Neither value asserts the data exists, so neither entails a route, and demanding one would invite a placeholder.
caseFor: Present so the record is otherwise clean and only the severity of unmeasured-route is under test.

unmeasured.why: No instrument was ever in the field for this, so nothing exists that compulsion could produce and there is no source that would close it.

unmeasured.what: A quantity with no agreed definition
unmeasured.why: No definition of the quantity exists, so it could not have been collected even in principle and naming a source would be naming one for something undefined.
